import json
import shutil
from pathlib import Path
from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

source = Path('runs/kaggle_staged_sft_serial_output')
out = Path('results/kaggle/staged-sft-serial-v2')
pull = Path('results/training/kaggle_staged_sft_serial.json')
download = json.loads(pull.read_text())
assert download['version'] == 2 and download['status'] == 'outputs_retrieved'
shutil.copytree(source, out, dirs_exist_ok=True)
pair = json.loads((out / 'pair_runtime.json').read_text())
cohorts = {}
for seed, count in [(200, 92), (300, 95)]:
    raw = out / f'shard-{seed}/results/raw/dice/qwen3.5-4b-staged-sft.jsonl'
    rows = [json.loads(line) for line in raw.read_text().splitlines()]
    assert [r['seed'] for r in rows] == list(range(seed, seed + count))
    assert all(len(r['rounds']) == 6 and r['provenance']['config']['adapter_sha256'] == pair['adapter_sha256'] for r in rows)
    runtime = json.loads((out / f'shard-{seed}/runtime.json').read_text())
    assert runtime['status'] == 'failed' and runtime['error'] == 'TimeoutError: Registered training wall budget exhausted'
    cohorts[str(raw)] = {'episodes': len(rows), 'missing_seeds': list(range(seed + count, seed + 100)), 'sha256': file_sha256(raw)}
r = {'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain all serial SFT episodes and exact wall-cap failure without scoring'}, pair['model_revision']),
     'download_receipt': str(pull), 'kernel': download['metadata']['id'], 'version': 2,
     'status': 'partial_at_wall_cap', 'saved_episodes': 187, 'required_episodes': 200, 'cohorts': cohorts,
     'files_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in sorted(out.rglob('*')) if p.is_file()},
     'calculation_source': Path(__file__).read_text(),
     'interpretation': 'Both serial workers reach the registered cap. Preserve all 187 episode bytes; evaluate only the missing 13 next. This is not a complete policy cohort or a quality nonimprovement.'}
Path('results/training/kaggle_staged_sft_serial_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(r,indent=2)+'\n')
p=Path('results/training/kaggle_budget.json');d=json.loads(p.read_text())
for session in d['sessions']:
 if session['kernel']==r['kernel'] and session['version']==2:
  session.update(status='partial_at_wall_cap',script_wall_seconds=pair['wall_seconds'],hours=pair['wall_seconds']/3600,
                 hours_basis='Downloaded script runtime; exact allocation billing boundaries unavailable.',observed_complete_at=download['polls'][-1]['at'],result_file=str(out/'pair_runtime.json'))
p.write_text(json.dumps(d,indent=2)+'\n')
print('Retained 187 complete episodes; 13 missing; scores sealed.')
